method: Per variant: fresh profile; OPENCODE_CONFIG file = mock provider + Isomux v2 config; OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT = Isomux v2 config (as start-server.ts does). GET /api/config and GET /api/agent with x-opencode-directory=<repo>. Then per agent and action: POST /api/session {location, agent}, prompt with GATE_CALL, every permission.asked in the session tree answered 'once', outcome from permission.asked / session.tool.success / session.tool.failed.
